import re
HEAD = re.compile(r'^== disasm: #<ISeq:(?P<iseq>.*?)@(?P<file>.+?):(?P<line>\d+) (?P<range>\(\d+,\d+\)-\(\d+,\d+\))>(?: \(catch: (?P<catch>\w+)\))?')
LOCAL = re.compile(r'^local table \(size: (?P<size>-?\d+), argc: (?P<argc>-?\d+) \[opts: (?P<opts>-?\d+), rest: (?P<rest>-?\d+), post: (?P<post>-?\d+), block: (?P<block>-?\d+), kw: (?P<kw>-?\d+@-?\d+), kwrest: (?P<kwrest>-?\d+)\]\)')
VAR = re.compile(r'\[\s*(?P<slot>\d+)\]\s*(?P<name>\S+?)@(?P<index>\d+)(?:<(?P<kind>\w+)>)?')
INSN = re.compile(r'^(?P<offset>\d{4}) (?P<insn>\S+)(?:\s+(?!(?:\(\s*\d+\))?(?:\[[A-Za-z]+\])?\s*$)(?P<operands>\S.*?))?(?:\s*\(\s*(?P<line>\d+)\))?(?:\s*\[(?P<events>[A-Za-z]+)\])?\s*$')
CATCH = re.compile(r'^\| catch type: (?P<type>\S+)\s+st: (?P<st>\d+)\s+ed: (?P<ed>\d+)\s+sp: (?P<sp>\d+)\s+cont: (?P<cont>\d+)')
SKIP = re.compile(r'^== catch table|^\|-+$')
LOCAL_KEYS = ('size', 'argc', 'opts', 'rest', 'post', 'block', 'kw', 'kwrest')

def parse(lines):
    iseqs, locs, insns, catches, skip = [], [], [], [], []
    il, ll, nl, cl = [], [], [], []
    cur = ''
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = HEAD.match(ln)
        if m:
            cur = m.group('iseq')
            rec = {'iseq': cur, 'file': m.group('file'), 'line': m.group('line'),
                   'range': m.group('range'), 'catch': m.group('catch') or ''}
            rec.update({k: '' for k in LOCAL_KEYS})
            iseqs.append(rec)
            il.append(i)
            continue
        m = LOCAL.match(ln)
        if m and iseqs:
            iseqs[-1].update({k: m.group(k) for k in LOCAL_KEYS})
            il.append(i)
            continue
        m = INSN.match(ln)
        if m:
            insns.append({'iseq': cur, 'offset': m.group('offset'), 'insn': m.group('insn'),
                          'operands': m.group('operands') or '', 'line': m.group('line') or '',
                          'events': m.group('events') or ''})
            nl.append(i)
            continue
        m = CATCH.match(ln)
        if m:
            catches.append({'iseq': cur, 'type': m.group('type'), 'st': m.group('st'),
                            'ed': m.group('ed'), 'sp': m.group('sp'), 'cont': m.group('cont')})
            cl.append(i)
            continue
        if ln.startswith('[') and VAR.search(ln):
            for v in VAR.finditer(ln):
                locs.append({'iseq': cur, 'slot': v.group('slot'), 'name': v.group('name'),
                             'index': v.group('index'), 'kind': v.group('kind') or ''})
            ll.append(i)
            continue
        if SKIP.match(ln):
            skip.append(i)
    blocks = [{'name': 'iseqs', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': il, 'records': iseqs},
              {'name': 'locals', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ll, 'records': locs},
              {'name': 'instructions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': nl, 'records': insns},
              {'name': 'catch_table', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': cl, 'records': catches}]
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
